tasks.subject: Task 1: EM UI model derivation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure function that turns a confirmed `SpecContractV2` into the Unit→EM grouping and per-EM state/transition info the EM-layer UI needs.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/spec-builder/code-builder-em-ui-model.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/code-builder-em-ui-model.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/spec-builder/code-builder-em-ui-model.ts", "src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/code-builder-em-ui-model.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/code-builder-em-ui-model.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["buildEmUiModel returns unitGroups + emById", "excluded units skipped", "missing EM contract yields empty arrays"]}
```
